title: GameTextField
responsibility: Preserve focused text drafts while reporting every keystroke for immediate unsaved-state tracking.

inputs.name: GameTextField.value
inputs.description: The committed value the game holds; the field displays it whenever no input event has occurred since mount or the last blur. While typed text is held, which lasts until the field blurs, changes to value are not displayed.

inputs.name: GameTextField.change
inputs.description: Called with the current text of the hx-input element on every input event, passed raw with no normalization. The component never calls it on blur or when value changes, and it does not catch exceptions raised by the callback.

inputs.name: GameTextField.label
inputs.description: Text passed as aria-label to the hx-input element when provided, unchanged and unvalidated. The component sets no default, so it is undefined when omitted.

inputs.name: GameTextField.placeholder
inputs.description: Hint text passed unchanged as the placeholder of the hx-input element. It defaults to an empty string, so the element gets an empty placeholder when omitted.

inputs.name: GameTextField.readonly
inputs.description: Forwarded unchanged as the readonly flag of the hx-input element, and defaults to false when omitted. The component does not check it in its input handler, which calls change on every input event.

outputs.name: GameTextField
outputs.description: The hx-input element the component renders, receiving value, placeholder, readonly and label. It shows the latest typed text until the field blurs and the value prop otherwise.
